help.formatHint: Accepts one vCard file (.vcf or .vcard). A single file can hold multiple contacts.
help.summary: How do I export my contacts?
help.iosStep1: Open the Contacts app and select the contacts you want to import.
help.iosStep3: Choose "Save to Files" and save the contact on your device.
help.iosStep4: In Tourenbuddy, tap "Import from file" and select the previously saved file.
help.androidStep1: If you see an "Import from contacts" button above, click it to select contacts directly.
help.androidStep2: Otherwise open the Contacts app and select the contact you want.
help.androidStep3: Tap the menu, then "Share" or "Export", and save the file on your device.
help.androidStep4: In Tourenbuddy, tap "Import from file" and select the previously saved file.
help.desktopStep1: macOS Contacts: select the contacts, then File → Export → Export vCard.
help.desktopStep2: Google Contacts: select the contacts, then Export and choose the vCard format.
help.desktopStep3: Outlook: open the contact, then File → Save As and choose vCard.
help.desktopStep4: Open TourenBuddy in your browser and import the saved file there.
